dynamic_steps.instruction: Trace and contain the implicated raw material supply chain from supplier 1 (PharmaRaw Egypt) to prevent further batches from being affected. Specifically, quarantine all raw materials received from supplier 1 within the manufacturing window of batch 21 (2026-07-25) and initiate an investigation to identify the root cause of the microbial contamination.
dynamic_steps.observation:
```sql
-- Step 4: Trace raw material supply chain from supplier 1 (PharmaRaw Egypt) within the manufacturing window of batch 21 (2026-07-25)
-- Identify all raw material receipts from supplier 1 between 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-25 (manufacturing window)
SELECT
    rm.ReceiptID,
    rm.RawMaterialID,
    rm.ReceiptDate,
    rm.QuantityReceived,
    rm.BatchID AS RawMaterialBatchID,
    po.ProductionOrderID,
    po.EmployeeID AS ProductionStaffID
FROM
    Raw_Material_Receipt rm
JOIN
    Production_Order po ON rm.ProductionOrderID = po.ProductionOrderID
WHERE
    rm.SupplierID = 1
    AND rm.ReceiptDate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-25'
ORDER BY
    rm.ReceiptDate;

-- Step 5: Quarantine all raw materials received from supplier 1 within the manufacturing window
INSERT INTO Quarantine_Log (QuarantineID, RawMaterialID, BatchID, QuarantineDate, Reason, Status)
SELECT
    NEXT_SEQUENCE_VALUE,
    rm.RawMaterialID,
    rm.BatchID,
    CURRENT_DATE,
    'Microbial contamination risk from supplier 1 (PharmaRaw Egypt) within manufacturing window of batch 21',
    'Quarantined'
FROM
    Raw_Material_Receipt rm
WHERE
    rm.SupplierID = 1
    AND rm.ReceiptDate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-25';

-- Step 6: Update status of quarantined raw materials to 'Quarantined'
UPDATE Raw_Material_Inventory
SET Status = 'Quarantined'
WHERE
    RawMaterialID IN (
        SELECT RawMaterialID
        FROM Raw_Material_Receipt
        WHERE SupplierID = 1
        AND ReceiptDate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-25'
    )
    AND BatchID IN (
        SELECT BatchID
        FROM Raw_Material_Receipt
        WHERE SupplierID = 1
        AND ReceiptDate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-25'
    );

-- Step 7: Initiate root cause investigation for microbial contamination
INSERT INTO Investigation (InvestigationID, InitiationDate, Reason, Status, AssignedTo)

INSERT INTO Investigation_Scope (InvestigationID, BatchID, RawMaterialID, SupplierID)

    (SELECT InvestigationID FROM Investigation WHERE InitiationDate = CURRENT_DATE AND Reason = 'Microbial contamination in raw materials from supplier 1 (PharmaRaw Egypt)'),
    b.BatchID,
    NULL,
    1
FROM

INSERT INTO Investigation_Scope (InvestigationID, BatchID, RawMaterialID, SupplierID)

    NULL,
    rm.RawMaterialID,
    1
FROM
    Raw_Material_Receipt rm
WHERE
    rm.SupplierID = 1
    AND rm.ReceiptDate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-25';
```
